data.short_description: G&B Hospitality recently signed the lease for a new Patty & Press smashburger location at the former Zoup! space in Bloomfield Township. Co-owner Goran Dimic told What Now Detroit the team is hoping to open around September or October. The restaurant will share the building with a FedEx Office Print & Ship Center.

data.status: change of concept / waiting on licensing
data.short_description: Culture Connects 707 owner James Simelton is proposing a change of concept on Howard Street, turning the existing venue into a coffee shop by day and comedy club by evening. Simelton has just applied for licensing and does not yet have an estimated opening date or a cafe menu.

data.location: 19300 Rinaldi St, Suite G, Porter Ranch, CA 91326
data.short_description: Santa Clarita's Hanasaki Sushi is expanding into the former Sushi Ko space in Porter Ranch, with the 1,700-square-foot venue featuring an L-shaped sushi bar and a red, black, and gray color scheme. Owner Johnny Younan said the space still needs a full renovation and the team is aiming for a November opening.

SoMa Social, a sports-inspired bar and eatery created by Oxford Hotels & Resorts LLC, opened on May 15, 2026 in San Francisco's Mid-Market district. The venue offers breakfast, lunch, dinner, happy hour, sports viewing, and group events, with an interior designed by Dunne Kozlowski featuring wall-to-wall TVs and a semi-private Huddle Lounge.

Claude's Comedy Club & Bar, owned by entertainment veteran Reid Benditt, is set to open on South Broad Street in Philadelphia. The venue will feature a bar and a separate showroom for stand-up comedy, with a menu of shareable finger foods, hot dogs, grilled cheese, cocktails, and beer.

data.location: 461 S Capitol Ave #15, San Jose, CA 95127
data.short_description: La Grullensa, a family-owned Mexican restaurant in East San Jose founded by the Galindo family in 1991, is closing its doors on May 25 with its last service on May 24. The team cited that the closure is due to circumstances beyond its control.

PopUp Bagels is opening its second San Diego County location in Oceanside, operated by local franchise partners Paul Goodman and Griffin Thall, known as "The Bagel Boyz." The opening celebration is set for May 22, 2026 from 8 a.m. to 11 a.m. and will feature a limited-time Blackberry Jalapeño Crunch Schmear created with Brian Malarkey.

Blue Collar, a comfort food restaurant in Miami's MiMo district founded in 2012 by Chef Daniel Serfer, officially closed on May 17 after its final dinner service. Chef Serfer announced the closure on Instagram without sharing a specific reason.

Fiorenza Italian, brought by Florence-raised restaurateur Jessi Qilafi, is opening in Alpharetta this summer. The restaurant will feature Tuscan dishes and house-made pastas with signature dishes including Pappardelle al Ragu, Pici Cacio e Pepe, and Bistecca alla Fiorentina.

data.status: opening date yet to be announced
data.short_description: Dough In The Box Donuts is expanding with a fourth location on Mitchell Street, opened by husband-and-wife team Jesus and Dannia Balestena. The new spot will serve as a grab-and-go style express store offering coffee, donuts, croissants, and bagels.
PITA Mediterranean Street Food is expanding to Roswell this year, opening in a 1,200-square-foot space. The chain is known for its Mediterranean cuisine.

The Southern Chef announced its upcoming seventh location at 5307 East Highland Drive in Jonesboro between Hytrol and the ABB factory. No opening timeline is available and the social media post says only that the location is "coming soon," with work still needed to convert the space.

data.status: set to begin welcoming guests next month
data.short_description: Ovoka Farm, a Virginia farm celebrated for its F1 wagyu, is launching a wagyu and wine dining experience in a historic manor at 750 Gap Run Road, set to begin welcoming guests next month. The tasting room will be inside the manor home and operate on a reservation-only basis at first.

data.status: preparing for its next chapter / coming
data.short_description: CHICHA San Chen, a Taiwanese tea house, is opening its second Massachusetts location at One Brattle Square in Cambridge's Harvard Square. Franchisee Andy Liao shared a first look at the upcoming space, which will be similar in size to the brand's Newbury Street shop at Lyrik.

The Artist Table, a chef residency and event space founded by Daishu McGriff, has closed its doors at 412 S Main with plans to reopen at a future location. McGriff announced the closure via social media and confirmed The Artist Table will return, though no new location or timeline has been announced.

Andy's Pizza is slated to take over the Sbarro space at Union Station, with plans to extend its bagel program to the new location. An opening timeline is not available, and the chain currently operates 14 locations across the DMV region.

data.status: upcoming / opening date not yet announced
data.short_description: Mesón, a Spanish tapas concept owned by Cameron McVeig, will take over the former Three One Four Pizzeria space at 1329 Gilman Street in Berkeley. The restaurant will be heavily inspired by César and reunites former César team members including chef Juan Gomez and Maggie Pond.

Fanoos Grills, a Mediterranean concept specializing in shawarma and grab-and-go offerings, is preparing to open its newest San Francisco location at 411 Columbus Ave at the end of June. Owner Adnan Alame said he is considering further Bay Area expansion in markets like San Jose, Santa Clara, and Hayward.

data.status: closed for remodeling / expected to reopen
data.short_description: Aviator's Restaurant inside Sacramento Executive Airport has been closed since Dec. 24 after a flooring project uncovered structural damage including deteriorated rebar, mold, asbestos, and water intrusion. The remodel is being handled by Sacramento County and the Department of Airports, with reopening projected in around two years.

data.status: permit applications filed / opening date not announced
data.short_description: Bongo Creamery Wynwood filed permit applications with the Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation to open a Häagen-Dazs at 50 NW 24th Street, Unit 104, in Miami's Wynwood neighborhood. An opening date has not been announced.

data.location: 3715 S State Hwy 161, Grand Prairie, TX 75052
data.short_description: Black Bear Diner plans to begin construction on a new corporate-owned location at 3715 S Highway 161 in Grand Prairie on May 18, with the project expected to be completed by December 15, 2026. The 4,800-square-foot restaurant will be built inside a newly constructed building in one of Grand Prairie's fastest-growing commercial corridors.

data.status: set to debut later this year
data.short_description: Chef Mike Cordero is bringing Capellini's Classic Italian, an old-school Italian restaurant with a modern flair, to 22850 Brambleton Plaza in Ashburn, taking over the former Rebel Taco Cantina space. The 3,500-square-foot restaurant will seat up to 75 indoors plus 80 on the patio and emphasize Northern Italian dishes.

Graze Craze, a charcuterie-focused franchise, is opening its first Ontario location in Stoney Creek. A ribbon-cutting event is expected to include Hamilton Mayor Andrea Horwath, and the location is locally owned and operated by Danielle Parks.

Popeyes is planning a new restaurant in Brighton as part of a 15-unit Greater Boston expansion led by franchisee Rahman Hashimi. The space will be roughly 1,727 square feet with seven customer seats, a rear kitchen, and one restroom.

data.location: 505 Oak Avenue, Suite C, Carlsbad, CA 92008
data.short_description: Amor y Magia, a Latin American-inspired restaurant from the team behind Same Same and Good Enough Cocktail Club, is set to open in Carlsbad next to Little Victory Wine Bar. The menu blends Filipino, Venezuelan, Mexican, and broader Latin American cuisine, with shared plates and a Gothic and Spanish Revival-inspired design.

Biscuit Belly, a Louisville-founded restaurant chain, is preparing to open its first Columbus location in the Grandview area, marking location No. 15 for the growing brand. Opening celebrations are set to begin June 6, and the location will feature a mural wall and a locally themed beverage.

Project LeanNation, a healthy-living brand offering ready-to-eat meals and coaching, is preparing to make its Orlando debut. The location will open in a retail center joining restaurants like Rita’s Italian Ice & Frozen Custard, Gator’s Dockside, and Wok N’ Roll.

data.location: 10570 W. Forest Hill Boulevard, Wellington, FL 33414
data.short_description: Valisi Consultants Corp. filed permit applications to open a Diadem Pickleball Complex in Wellington, which would be the second U.S. location. The complex will include courts, a pro shop, and an in-house restaurant offering pizza, salads, beer, wine, and soft drinks.

50's Diner is set to open in Dowdy Plaza on the southeast corner of Carrier Drive and International Drive, per plan review documents submitted by 50's Diner LLC. The restaurant will offer dine-in service, curbside pickup, and delivery, joining nearby restaurants like SLAP Hand Ripped Noodles and Divina Carne Brazilian Steakhouse.

Charcoal Group of Restaurants is preparing to open a new Wildcraft Grill + Long Bar location in Burlington as part of a major Ontario expansion. The company plans to invest between $25 million and $30 million CAD over the next 18 months.

Charcoal Group is planning a new Wildcraft Grill + Long Bar location in the Niagara Region, which will also include a Beertown restaurant alongside it. The projects are expected to roll out over the next year and a half.
Charcoal Group is planning a new Beertown restaurant in the Niagara Region as part of its Ontario expansion. The Beertown will be developed alongside a new Wildcraft Grill + Long Bar.
Charcoal Group has scheduled a new Beertown location for Peterborough as part of its Ontario expansion. The project is expected to roll out over the next 18 months.
Charcoal Group has scheduled a new Beertown location for Richmond Hill as part of its Southern Ontario expansion. The project is expected to roll out over the next year and a half.

data.location: 2427 N Atlantic Ave, Suite 13, Daytona Beach, FL 32118
data.short_description: Wingstop, the chicken wing chain with more than 2,500 locations, is planning a new Daytona Beach location per plan review documents submitted by Momagic 22 LLC. The location will be near Bellair Plaza, joining restaurants like Miyabi Sushi, Aria Pizzeria, and Big Tunas Beach Bar & Grill.

Frosti Ice Cream is preparing to open in Bunnell with milkshakes, ice cream, Italian ice, coffee, and iced tea, including dairy-free options. The shop will join restaurants like Rehab Sports Bar, Los Dos Potrillos Mexican Restaurant, and Domenech Corner.

Pear Plum, an all-day cafe, specialty coffee shop, and wine bar from owners St. Elmo and Christina Crawford, is scheduled to open in downtown San Diego. The concept will transition from a daytime cafe to an evening wine destination, featuring wines from regions including Bordeaux, Burgundy, and Napa Valley.

data.location: 904 E. Las Olas Boulevard, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33301
data.short_description: The Restaurant People are opening Naia, a Mediterranean cuisine restaurant with Asian influences, at the former home of Mango's on Las Olas Boulevard. The restaurant will feature expansive indoor and outdoor spaces with a vibrant central bar offering curated cocktails, premium wines, and shareable plates.

data.location: Riverfront Plaza, 2 W Independent Dr, Jacksonville, FL 32202
data.short_description: Atlas Restaurant Group's proposal to design, build, and lease a restaurant at Riverfront Plaza on the Downtown Northbank moved forward after a Downtown Investment Authority committee voted 3-0 to recommend it. Atlas cited its Choptank restaurants as a brand that would influence the Jacksonville location.

The owners of The Stand comedy club are planning a second location called The Stand West inside Chelsea Market. Permit documents show a 140-person-capacity comedy club in the cellar level, with a small menu of Italian-influenced bar fare and a full liquor license being pursued.

Thorough Bread Bakery & Cafe, founded by Molly Newman after she perfected sourdough during the pandemic, is expected to open in a historic building that once housed the old Coca-Cola bottling plant. The bakery uses all-natural, unbromated, unrefined flour with a tagline of "Elegantly Unrefined."

Hard Pressed Burgers founders Justin Pa'ala and Eddie Evans have opened their first brick-and-mortar restaurant in San Marco. The owners have stated the San Marco location won't be the only Hard Pressed Burgers restaurant and are already exploring sites for the next one.

Niko's Bar-N-Grill, owned by Christopher Ennis, is set to open in Baton Rouge. The city recently approved its liquor license, and the team is now hiring bartenders, with the bar dubbed the "new best nightclub" and previously operating as a pop-up serving barbecue and boiled meats.

Jet's Pizza franchisees Jeff and Bob Phelps are preparing to open a second Jacksonville location on Beach Blvd. The Phelpses, originally from the Detroit area, launched their first location at 11250 Old St Augustine Rd. about two years ago.

Bain Barbecue has moved up the opening of its second location in Germantown from July to May 19. The converted Arby's will seat up to 58 guests inside, with a patio under construction to accommodate another 40 visitors.

Cousin Vinny's Sandwich Co. is expanding with a second location in St. Pete's Grand Central District, in a space previously home to Little Philly. The restaurant is known for sandwiches on Tuscan-style Schiaccata bread and cutlet sandwiches, and was recently recommended by the Michelin Guide.

data.store_name: Gordian Knot GR Inc. (yet-to-be-named Greek restaurant)
data.status: An opening date has not been announced
data.short_description: Alexandros Grimpas is planning to open a two-story Greek restaurant at 170 7th Ave, offering classic Greek dishes like spanakopita, gyro, avgolemono soup, and kebabs. The restaurant will have seating capacity for 88 guests including 9 bar seats, with plans for live music on the first floor and a full liquor license.

The Malibu Diner closed in February after owner Alexandros Grimpas could not reach a lease deal with the building's owner. The diner had been offering discounted meals to blind guests from the nearby Selis Manor apartment complex.

data.status: scheduled to open just in time to cool off from Miami's summer days
data.short_description: Sweet Melody, a Miami-born ice cream shop, is opening its fifth location in Kendall's London Square. The shop will offer 16 flavors by the scoop, pints, milkshakes, and sundaes in its classic record store-meets ice cream shop decor.

data.status: shooting for an Oct. 1 opening date
data.short_description: A new donut shop called Uniontown Baking Company is in the plans for 264 W Marine Drive in Astoria, from local Glenn Taggart who hired Kurt Rummel for the menu. The team plans on baking donut staples like fritters, long johns and glazed options, with seating available but no drinks served.
Fellas Vinoir, a European-style cafe and wine bar, is planning to open at 344 Corey Ave on St. Pete Beach. It will serve breakfast by day and a wine-focused menu by night.

data.status: preparing to take the next step-a liquor license hearing
data.short_description: Kareem's Lebanese Kitchen, an acclaimed Florida concept, is preparing to open at 212 Boardwalk Place in the storefront that previously housed Bach to Rock. A liquor license hearing with the Montgomery County Alcohol Beverage Services Board is scheduled for May 21.

ShoYu Restaurant & Bar is preparing to open a new location in downtown Peabody, taking over the former Century Bank building. This will mark the fourth location for ShoYu, which already operates in Saugus, Andover, and Boston's Chinatown.

The Southern Chef is preparing to open its sixth location at 1324 Redwolf Boulevard, taking over a former Advance Auto Parts. The restaurant will gain 7,000 square feet of space and continue serving homestyle Southern comfort cuisine.

Andrew Ticer and Michael Hudman are opening Rosie's Tavern, a cocktail lounge and restaurant, on the second floor of 6695 Poplar Avenue. The menu, overseen by chef de cuisine Jaik Hunt, will include a raw bar, superior steaks, and a memorable burger.

Andrew Ticer and Michael Hudman are opening Josephine Estelle on the ground floor of 6695 Poplar Avenue, serving "an ode to Italian-American cuisine." The restaurant's main focus will be pastas, with customers able to watch the dish being prepared through a window.

Pure Vida Miami has set an opening date of May 21 for its first Virginia location at 8296 Glass Alley in the Mosaic District. The fast-casual chain offers healthy, fresh food including vegan and gluten-free options, with all-day breakfast, bowls, salads, sandwiches, wraps, and plates.

Bonita Taqueria y Rotisserie is preparing to open a third location at 4063 24th Street in Noe Valley. The fast-casual Mexican concept is known for its rotisserie chicken and will introduce permanent menu additions and expanded brunch service across all three locations.

data.location: 13925 City Center Dr., Chino Hills, CA 91709
data.status: full renovation of the space is underway and should wrap up this summer
data.short_description: Benihana is planning a new Chino Hills location at The Shoppes at Chino Hills, taking over the former RA Sushi space. The restaurant, known for its teppanyaki experience, is owned by The ONE Group and serves Japanese cuisine including sushi, steak, chicken and seafood.

data.location: 13925 City Center Dr., Chino Hills, CA 91709
data.short_description: RA Sushi at The Shoppes at Chino Hills has closed, with Benihana taking over the space. RA Sushi is also owned by The ONE Group.

data.location: The Village at Wexford, Hilton Head Island, SC
data.short_description: Nosh New York Bagels is preparing to debut its second location at The Village at Wexford on Hilton Head Island. The 750-square-foot space will serve as a dedicated takeout location with a mobile pickup window, offering the same bagels, sandwiches and wraps as the flagship shop.

Scholars American Bistro & Cocktail Lounge will officially close this weekend after 15 years at 25 School St in downtown Boston. The venue was a favorite among college students, celebrated for its upscale pub food, weekend DJ nights, and karaoke Tuesdays.

Off The Rails, a Worcester-based hotspot, is slated to open its second location at 25 School St in late summer 2026, taking over the former Scholars space. The venue is known for high-energy nightlife, live music, themed events, and Nashville-inspired fare.

Push Pull cafe is set to take over a former Starbucks at 7737 SW Capitol Highway in Multnomah, marking its third Portland location. The shop serves coffees as glass pours and pour overs from regions like Ethiopia, Costa Rica and Columbia, along with typical brews.

Stix & Savor Asian Cuisine is slated to take the 8,800-square-foot building at 3102 Piedmont Road in Buckhead. Javarius Gay, who operates Prime on Peachtree, Prime Cigar, and other concepts, will open the new restaurant.

data.location: 3111 W Chandler Blvd #2142, Chandler, AZ (Chandler Fashion Center)
data.short_description: Sip Fresh is opening a new location at Chandler Fashion Center, targeting a June 13 grand opening. The California-based beverage brand is built around handcrafted fruit-based beverages including smoothies, fruit bowls, fruit-infused teas, and the trademarked Cha Cha Chamoy drink.

data.location: 6800 N 95th Ave #865, Glendale, AZ (Tanger Outlets Phoenix)
data.status: expected to debut later this year
data.short_description: Sip Fresh is expanding with another Arizona location at Tanger Outlets Phoenix in Glendale, expected to debut later this year. The shop will offer handcrafted fruit-based beverages, smoothies, fruit bowls, and specialty drinks made with fresh fruit.

Cledis Burgers & Beer is preparing to open a fourth Tennessee location at 1211 Greenland Drive in Murfreesboro, taking over the former Boro Bar & Grill site. The fast-casual concept serves smash burgers, sandwiches, wings, and rotating taps of local and regional beers.
The Boro Bar & Grill closed last year after operating at 1211 Greenland Drive in Murfreesboro for more than 40 years. The site will be taken over by Cledis Burgers & Beer.

The Village Green Restaurant, a farm-to-table restaurant on Prospect Street in Ridgewood, is set to close permanently with its final meal on June 6. The restaurant, situated inside a historic 1896 carriage house, has been part of the community since 1989 and is known for seasonal tasting menus and a BYOB policy.

data.location: 13378 U.S. Hwy 87 W, La Vernia, TX 78121
data.status: taken a step toward potential expansion after a zoning-related application was recently received
data.short_description: On The Grind, a drive-thru coffee concept, has submitted a zoning-related application to the City of La Vernia for a proposed site at 13378 U.S. Hwy 87 W. The Texas-based chain is known for its drive-thru format serving coffee, energy drinks, and other quick-serve beverages.

data.location: 2753 E. Eastland Center Drive, West Covina, CA 91791
data.short_description: Brazilian steakhouse Fogo de Chão will open at the Eastland Center in West Covina this year, taking over a former TGI Fridays. The site is currently under construction and should be completed in October, featuring menu items like bone-in ribeye, filet mignon, lamb chops, and the Market Table.

data.location: 2753 E. Eastland Center Drive, West Covina, CA 91791
data.short_description: The former TGI Fridays at 2753 E. Eastland Center Drive in West Covina is being taken over by Fogo de Chão. The space is currently under construction.

data.location: 1200 El Paseo de Saratoga, West San Jose, CA
data.short_description: Sweetgreen is opening a new Saratoga + Campbell location at El Paseo de Saratoga in West San Jose on May 19, 2026. The 2,406 sq. ft. restaurant will operate daily from 10 am to 10 pm, featuring California-sourced produce and a menu of signature salads, warm bowls, protein plates, and sides. Preview events with complimentary meals are scheduled for May 15 and 16.

data.location: 1900 N. Highland Ave., Suite 6B, Los Angeles, CA 90068
data.short_description: Pita & Pie is seeking an ABC license for a new restaurant in the Hollywood area at 1900 N. Highland Ave., Suite 6B. Little information is known about the concept, and there are no website or social media accounts created for the brand. Amer Nackoud is behind the concept, according to the ABC permit filing.

Austin food truck Espadas de Brazil is opening a brick-and-mortar Brazilian steakhouse in Bastrop at 1507 Chestnut St., a space that formerly housed Stem & Stone. The brand is hiring for the new location and recently shared a "coming soon" post. Owner Robinson Figueiredo serves dishes such as spicy garlic picanha and protein-centered plates.

Seaviche Tacos & Bowls has signed a lease at 32500 Gratiot Avenue in Roseville for its third location. Owner Evan Shina does not have an opening date right now. The Mexican seafood concept offers tacos, burritos, bowls, quesadillas, and family trays.

KP's Kitchen and Bar is closing its Bellaire location in the Bissonnet Corner area, with its final day on May 31. The Spring Valley location will remain open. Owner Kerry Pauly cited a decision to refocus his energy on the original Spring Valley location.

Burger chain Jaggers is preparing to open a new location in Winston-Salem at the former Twin Peaks space near Hanes Mall Boulevard. Operated by Texas Roadhouse, Jaggers features burgers, chicken sandwiches, salads, fries, and milkshakes. The new restaurant adds to the company's growing North Carolina presence.

Ike's Café & Grill has opened a new 3,200-square-foot restaurant in Marietta with a ribbon-cutting and community celebration on May 8. The full-service restaurant serves African-inspired breakfast, lunch, and dinner with both indoor and outdoor seating. Menu items include smoky jollof rice, suya, egusi soup, grilled meats and fish, and puff puff.

Harvey's Deli, a family-owned sandwich shop in Katy known for East Coast-style sandwiches, has closed after five years of business. Owners Tierra and Ted Tyman cited the struggling economy and high overhead of running a small business as reasons for the closure. The announcement was shared on social media on May 13.

Esther Rum, a women-owned premium spirits brand, has launched in select locations across Columbus. Founded by Margaret Kerr-Jarrett and Emunah Winer, the premium Colombian-imported rum is bottled locally at Echo Spirits in Columbus. The brand aims to elevate rum's perception with a flavor profile similar to reposado tequila.

Ted's Hot Dogs will open its newest Chandler location on May 23, 2026, continuing its Arizona expansion. The new restaurant features a retro-inspired design, a spacious outdoor patio, indoor gathering spaces, a walk-up ice cream window, and the brand's first drive-thru. A two-day grand opening celebration will include giveaways, Buffalo-themed festivities, and free ice cream.

data.location: 100 Corte Madera Town Center, Corte Madera, CA 94925
data.short_description: Vietnamese fast-casual chain Asian Box is set to open at 100 Corte Madera Town Center in Corte Madera this Fall. Founded in 2011 by Chad Newton and chef Gracie Nguyen, the chain offers 100% gluten-free, customizable Vietnamese-inspired street food. Popular menu items include The Workout and Chef Gracie's Grandma's Pho.

Ristobar, a longtime Italian restaurant in San Francisco's Marina District, will close on Memorial Day Monday after 22 years of service. The Chestnut Street space will reopen as Eria Marina, a 5,300 sq ft indoor-outdoor events venue through a partnership with Eria Events. The restaurant is owned by pastry chef Gary Rulli and his wife, Jeannie.

Sushi Kobashi, driven by sushi chef Gang Lin who was part of the Michelin Star-winning team at Yoshino, is coming to Chelsea at the former Hana Sushi space. The eight-seat restaurant will specialize in an omakase experience starting at $250 per guest, infused with Chinese ingredients and premium sake. Classic sushi and sashimi will also be available a la carte.

The hospitality team behind Grove Street Social and Grand Street Social is planning a new gastropub concept called Clake & Moore Kitchen and Bar at 201 8th Ave. in Chelsea. The first floor will be a sit-down restaurant with 49-person seating capacity and the second floor will be a private event space for 74 guests. The menu will feature elevated pub food with sections dedicated to Anthony Bourdain.

Mack Allen's is a new fine-dining destination from restaurateur Mack McDonald, set to open in July 2026 as an anchor tenant at 5POP in the River Oaks-Uptown area. The 16,000-square-foot space includes a main dining room, three private dining spaces (Boardroom, Champagne Room, Estate Room), and a botanical garden-inspired patio. The menu features prime beef, American wagyu, seafood, chargrilled oysters, and sushi.

Lou Malnati's Pizzeria has completed an expansion of its South Loop location, adding approximately 2,400 square feet to bring the restaurant to nearly 8,400+ square feet overall. The updated space includes a new full-service bar, additional dining room seating, and a private events space accommodating up to 50 guests. The expansion was completed while the restaurant continued regular operations.

Stäge Kitchen & Bar is opening its second location in Dunwoody on May 15, 2026, inside Campus 244's Element Hotel by Westin. The high-energy global fusion restaurant features small plates such as duck fried rice with XO sauce, grilled Spanish octopus, and lamb lollipops. The new spot expands the brand following five successful years in Peachtree Corners.

Churp, a new fast-casual healthy bowl concept from founder Tyler Helikson, is preparing to open at Olde Raleigh Village. The restaurant is centered on customizable bowls designed for convenience and will feature a dedicated kids menu with bento box-style meals. Helikson is also behind the Happy + Hale brand.

data.location: Near 87th Street and Cottage Grove, Chicago (Address not specified)
data.short_description: Gig's Gourmet Baked Potato is a new food truck and catering operation on the South Side of Chicago founded by chef Gig McFadden. The truck specializes in gourmet loaded baked potatoes alongside comfort food and signature desserts such as hot Hennessy wings, jerk chicken salad, and Mama's pound cake. It operates Tuesday through Saturday from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m.

data.location: 3316 SE Federal Highway, Suite A, Stuart, FL
data.short_description: C.R. Chicks, the Florida-born rotisserie chicken restaurant, has filed permit applications to open a location at 3316 SE Federal Highway, Suite A in Stuart, in the Wedgewood Commons Shopping Center. No official opening date has been announced. The restaurant is known for fresh rotisserie chicken roasted over Brazilian oak logs, along with sandwiches, pastas, and chicken pot pies.

C.R. Chicks announced in January it would open a Boynton Beach location. That restaurant is expected to open Fall 2026. The brand is known for its fresh rotisserie chicken seasoned with lemon pepper and basted in house marinade and sea salt.

PopStroke, an interactive miniature golf entertainment venue backed by Tiger Woods, is coming to Miami Freedom Park. The venue combines golf with food and drinks, offering items like smash burgers, ribs, tacos, sushi, and a full bar. It is expected to open some time in 2026, although an exact opening date has not been announced.

data.location: 2711 S Alma School Rd, Mesa, AZ 85210
data.short_description: Paladino's Italian Eatery, a family-owned Chicago-style comfort food restaurant, plans to open a new outpost in Mesa, marking its second Arizona location after Apache Junction. The company is targeting a June opening, though an official date has not been confirmed. The menu features pizzas, sandwiches, pasta dishes, and signature items like Chicago-style Italian beef sandwiches and specialty pizzas.

data.location: 1605 E New Hope Dr Building 1, Leander, TX 78641
data.status: project is in the works / construction slated to begin in September
data.short_description: Local brewpub Pinthouse is opening a new location in Leander as a ground-up construction of a 13,640-square-foot restaurant and brewery with an outdoor beer garden. Construction is slated to begin in September and the project should conclude by July 2027. Pinthouse currently has five locations, offering beer and Pinthouse Pizza along with salads and sandwiches.

data.status: slated to open / in the early stages of development
data.short_description: Paper Rice, a local Vietnamese fast-casual restaurant, is opening a new 1,900-square-foot location in Sawtelle, marking its first venture into the west side of Los Angeles. The location is in the early stages of development and is slated to open in late 2026. The menu features spring rolls, spring bowls, and bánh mì with build-your-own and made-to-order options.
